description: This file contains utility functions for traversing, accessing, and printing elements within a distributed checkpoint state dictionary in PyTorch, including handling of tensors, sharded tensors, and distributed tensors.

methods.name: _keep_visiting_tensors
methods.description: Determines if a value should be visited based on whether it is a torch.Tensor.

methods.name: traverse_state_dict
methods.description: Recursively traverses a state dictionary, applying a visitor function to leaf elements containing tensors or mappings.

methods.name: traverse_state_dict_v_2_3
methods.description: Enhanced traversal that short-circuits when collections do not contain tensors, with a visitor function.

methods.name: set_element
methods.description: Sets a value in a nested dictionary structure along a specified path.

methods.name: get_element
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a nested dictionary structure at a specified path, with default fallback.

methods.name: _print_nested
methods.description: Recursively prints details of tensors, sharded tensors, and distributed tensors.

methods.name: print_tensor
methods.description: Callback function to print tensor-related information during traversal.
